scope: Synthetic captured-state fixture, restored to a second database in a disposable PostgreSQL 17 cluster reachable only through its private Unix socket. Checks use actual service and browser role privileges and independent local SQL sessions.
sourceBaseline: Dated zero-policy saved-reading and broad EXP/Circle grants from reviewed catalog projections with synthetic members and content.

concurrentCases.name: Concurrent exact create commits one listing and replays one receipt
Competing last-seat joins preserve capacity and create one new receipt
A new same-value join advances revision and blocks a stale leave
Rolled-back RSVP leaves the waiting response eligible and no orphan receipt
Detail waiting on leave returns without the private meeting URL or RSVP

limits: This run used the staged full-chain SQL list and separate connections. Practice and Live Council remain covered by their own restore evidence. Hosted Data API/schema cache, the production archive, account providers and physical devices still need acceptance.
